notes:
REF-BM-05: No delete API or UI action exists.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are offered as checkbox choices, but tag-entry autocomplete is not implemented.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and notes but omits the URL.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Bookmarks have a fixed created-date order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and viewed, but they are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF download/storage exists.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Archiving is reversible, but permanent deletion is absent, so the full distinction is incomplete.
REF-BM-29: Saved search/tag bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are available.
